description: FEEDBACK group slice: ProgressBar, Spinner, Meter, StatusBar, HintBar, KeyHint. Same stable IDs as v1/registry.json; ref_source lists reference source symbols verified present in the cited files. src/ tree is identical between ref_commit and head_commit, so cited lines hold for both. ProgressBar is render_bar, Spinner is spinner_frame plus render_spinner and render_indeterminate; StatusBar, HintBar, and KeyHint are the like-named widgets.

handlers: render_bar: label, track, percent, 2-cell suffix per status
Live page: build advance, pause/resume toggle, restart, done status
thresholds: label needs width above label+8; track below 6 cells shows the percent only
build rate 0.006 per Tick: 167 ticks from 0 to Done
timers: Live build advances on Tick; samples are static
early_returns: empty area returns; tiny width drops label+track
notes: green is reserved for Done; running bars are white-70

handlers: render_spinner: accent frame plus secondary label
render_indeterminate: accent segment sweeping the subtle track
thresholds: ten braille frames modulo tick; segment (track/5) clamped 2..8
sweep period is track+seg; label follows the bar label rule
timers: frame and sweep position both derive from the tick
notes: second captures must differ from first: never frozen

handlers: Meter::render in Line and Block visuals via palette()
level() maps each tone to a level or to no run
thresholds: Line track below 6 and Block bar below 4 show the value only
timers: Refreshing reads the spinner frame from the tick
early_returns: empty area returns; Error/Unknown draw no run at all
notes: a quota is never green; Block value starts one cell in; Exhausted suffix is bold

handlers: layout: priority eviction, left truncation, group placement
render: plane fill, busy spinner, inline meter, hover, clicks
shell assembly: chrome demo, holla draw_status, capsule meters, screen StatusBits
thresholds: GAP 3 between items, EDGE 1 at each side; inline meter track 10
timers: busy spinners read the tick; layout is static per width
early_returns: empty area returns; nothing left to drop ends eviction
notes: center leaves first, then right, then left; the last left item truncates with …; capsule freshness adds stale/error chips

handlers: resolve: first present layer wins, else the empty default
render: delegate to keyhint with badge, status, centered
thresholds: one row; shells truncate status to width minus 4 (holla minus 8 for the error prefix)
timers: none: the hint row is static per layer
early_returns: all-None layers resolve to the empty default
notes: chrome orders menu, context, screen; shells order modal, menu, screen, fallback and render centered

handlers: render_aligned: badge, right status, hints or centered block
render_toned and render wrap it with default tone/align
thresholds: two cells stay reserved while more hints follow; badge truncates to width minus 2
timers: none: the hint row is static per call
notes: drop from the right with a faint …; Error ! and Warning ▲ survive monochrome; nothing paints outside the area
